completion_claim: This execution completes only the CRUMAC-5 and CRUMAC-7 live-observability slice: a deployed versioned read-only CLI contract, a strict CLI-only macOS consumer, truthful current fleet and queue detail, 60-second foreground and 300-second background refresh, explicit freshness and last-known-state behavior, automated validation, and runtime proof.
